stable.notes: Running is a burst, not a treadmill. A session is working almost all the time, so the sprint used to loop forever; running and patrol now settle on the idle clip most of the time and break into the action about 30% of it, never for more than two beats. The character also holds one size and one baseline through an animation — frames were being scaled individually, so a crouched stride got enlarged to match a standing one. Jedi Miles Windu ships as the default with ten animated states and 74 frames. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
